description: GANGZII speech-quality evaluation corpus (M28 Priority B). Owner-approved, non-sensitive synthetic content: no real customer data, no private documents, no personal information. Each item is synthesized exactly as written after GANGZII's bounded text normalization; the normalized form is recorded per run alongside the original.
reviewNote: The owner approves this corpus by review/commit; any text change re-baselines the comparison.

items.text: Bean Intelligence turns ideas into finished media.
GANGZII is the audio specialist.

The production pipeline measures every generated segment, validates each artifact with a real decoder, records loudness and true peak next to the receipt, and only then hands the finished narration to the video studio.

When the narrator finishes recording the introduction that spans nearly a full minute of continuous speech, the timeline editor still keeps every sentence boundary editable without touching the music bed underneath it.

Welcome to GANGZII. This paragraph is a listening sample with several sentences of different lengths. Some are short. Others carry a longer thought across two clauses, so the narrator has to breathe somewhere in the middle. The paragraph ends with a plain closing sentence.
